title: Sep 6, 2021: the forecast turned up before the queue did
why: On Sep 5 8 ships were loitering within 60 nm (vs 14 a week earlier) and 5 were inbound.
model_note: Forecast for Sep 6: 63 ships waiting. Tomorrow-equals-today said 61, the 7-day mean 59. Actual: 64. Why it went up: 5.4 ships inbound within 60 nm; queue rose by 4 ships during today.
